title: Sheet-Pan Lemon Herb Salmon & Vegetables
description: One tray of lemon-butter salmon, baby potatoes and tenderstem broccoli with a garlicky herb dressing — all in under 45 minutes.

ingredients.name: flaky sea salt and black pepper

steps.text: Heat the oven to 220°C fan. Toss the potatoes with 2 tbsp olive oil and plenty of salt, spread over a large baking tray and roast for 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, whisk the lemon juice and zest, garlic, dill, parsley, melted butter and the remaining olive oil into a herb dressing.
Push the potatoes to the edges of the tray, tuck in the broccoli and lemon slices, and lay the salmon fillets skin-side down in the middle.
Brush the salmon with half the dressing and season everything well.
Roast for 12–14 minutes, until the salmon is just opaque and flakes easily and the broccoli is charred at the tips.
Rest for 2 minutes, then drizzle with the remaining dressing and serve straight from the tray.

notesMarkdown:
## Timing

Thicker fillets (about 4 cm) need the full 14 minutes; thin tail fillets can be done in 9–10.
Check early — **salmon keeps cooking** after it leaves the oven.

## Swap the veg

Use whatever the tray can hold: **asparagus, green beans, courgette** or fennel all roast
well at the same temperature. Just stagger the timings by size.

## Leftovers

Flake the cold salmon over a green salad for lunch the next day. The dressing doubles
as a vinaigrette if you add a spoonful of Dijon.
